caption: The drawing shows a single metallic skewer laid horizontally on a tan rectangular background in the center of a cream-colored larger sheet. The skewer is elongated and tapers to a fine point on the right side, while the left end terminates in a circular hoop with a small, flattened end featuring a slight decorative flourish. The handle of the skewer is inscribed with the letters "G H E E" and a small horizontal line near the hoop. The color of the skewer is mostly gray with subtle shading and a slight blue tint, while the hoop at the left end is outlined with a faint purple line and some light brown coloring. To the right of the skewer, there is plain printed text reading, "SKEWER CASE 4-15250 LENGTH- 9"." The tan background rectangle containing the drawing is bordered by pencil outlines and is mounted on a larger sheet with some visible yellowish adhesive marks at the corners.
title: Silver Skewer
